## MCP - Documents Process (RFC-014 Phase 2)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/documents/process

**Purpose:** Process document with async callback - simplified Code node architecture

**Input:**
- `job_id`: UUID from chatbot-core
- `file_url` / `file_base64`: Document
- `action`: translate | summarize | custom
- `params`: { target_language, format, etc. }
- `plugin_context`: { api_keys, pricing, custom_actions, ocr_thresholds }
- `callback_url`: URL to POST result

**Custom Actions (2.1):**
- Define in `plugin_context.custom_actions[action_name].webhook_url`
- Validates webhook_url exists before routing

**OCR Thresholds (2.2):**
- Passed to sub-workflows via `plugin_context.ocr_thresholds`
